title: vt-manage-virtual-terminal-custom-settings.html
content: Hierarchical Structure The {{variable.CS_BlackthornPayVirtualTermina}} custom settings are hierarchical. This means you can apply custom settings at the organizational level for all users, for specific Salesforce users, or for users with specific profiles. Apply at the organizational level: click {{variable.button_new}} above the “Default Organization Level Value” section. Apply for specific Salesforce users or users with specific profiles: Click {{variable.button_new}} in the lower section. Access Custom Settings Navigate to Salesforce Setup. In the Quick Find box, search for and click “Custom Settings.” Click {{variable.Button_SF_Manage}} next to the {{variable.CS_BlackthornPayVirtualTermina}} custom setting. Spreedly / Cybersource {{snippet.PAY_CS_VT_ShowAddress_Spreedly}} Custom Settings Dynamically Displayed Settings The following configurations for the {{variable.Component_BTLWCVirtualTerminal}} will by dynamically displayed. Settings Applied at the (Global) Custom Setting Level If {{variable.CS_VT_HideCardTab}} = "True" (checked), the card tab will be hidden. If {{variable.CS_VT_HideCardTab}} = "False" (unchecked), the card tab will be shown. Settings Applied at the Component Level If {{variable.CS_VT_HideCardTab}} = "False" (unchecked) on both the component and global level settings, the card tab will be shown. If {{variable.CS_VT_HideCardTab}} = False (unchecked) on the component level but {{variable.CS_VT_HideCardTab}} = "True" (checked) on the global level, then the card tab will be hidden. If {{variable.CS_VT_HideCardTab}} = "True" (checked) on both the component and global level settings, the card tab will be hidden. Configurable Settings {{variable.Field_MgVTCustmSet_DefNewPM}} : Sets the "New Payment Method" option as the default option on the Action menu. {{variable.Field_MgVTCustmSet_DisableAmt}} : Prevents users from populating the {{variable.Field_VT_Amount}} field in the Virtual Terminal. {{variable.Field_MgVTCustmSet_DisaNewChrg}} : Removes the “New Single Charge" option from the Action menu. {{variable.Field_MgVTCustmSet_DisablePG}} : When enabled, this setting renders the {{variable.Field_VT_PaymentGateway}} field as Read-Only. Note: The {{variable.Field_VT_PaymentGateway}} field is only visible in orgs with multiple {{variable.Object_PaymentGateway}} s. {{variable.Field_MgVTCustmSet_DisPMFilter}} : When this is checked all the {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}} s are loaded regardless of the {{variable.Object_Contact}} / {{variable.Object_Account}} set in the {{variable.Component_VirtualTerminal}} . This setting takes sharing rules into consideration. If a user does not have access to a {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}} , they will not see it as an option in {{variable.Component_VirtualTerminal}} . {{variable.Field_MgVTCustmSet_DisRelattTo}} : Makes the {{variable.Field_VT_RelatedTo}} field read-only. {{variable.Field_MgVTCustmSet_HideParent}} : Removes the Parent Object field from the {{variable.Component_VirtualTerminal}} . {{variable.Field_MgVTCustmSet_HidProcType}} : Sets the {{variable.Field_VT_ProcessType}} selection to "Capture Now" and removes the picklist from the {{variable.Component_VirtualTerminal}} . {{variable.Field_MgVTCustmSet_HideRelatTo}} : Removes the {{variable.Field_VT_RelatedTo}} field from the {{variable.Component_VirtualTerminal}} . {{variable.Field_MgVTCustmSet_PMSuccesMsg}} : When a value is added to this setting, the value is used as the text in the success message box that appears when a {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}} is created in the {{variable.Component_VirtualTerminal}} . {{variable.Field_MgVTCustmSet_RelToDefObj}} : The object added to this field ( {{variable.Object_Contact}} , {{variable.Object_Account}} , or {{variable.Object_Lead}} ) will be the object that displays first in the {{variable.Field_VT_RelatedTo}} field on the {{variable.Component_VirtualTerminal}} . {{variable.Field_MgVTCustmSet_ShowAddress}} : Exposes additional fields to capture a full billing address when adding new {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}} s. {{variable.Field_MgVTCustmSet_TransSucMsg}} : When a value is added to this setting, the value is used as the text in the success message box that appears when a {{variable.Object_Transaction}} is captured in the {{variable.Component_VirtualTerminal}} . Payment Option Features Admins can control whether users see the ACH (Bank) and/or Card payment options on the {{variable.Component_VirtualTerminal}} ’s New Payment Method screen. Disable New Payment Methods The {{variable.Field_MgVTCustmSet_DisablNewPM}} setting can remove the “New Payment Method” option from the Action menu. When the {{variable.Field_MgVTCustmSet_DisablNewPM}} custom setting is set to “True” (checked) and either the {{variable.CS_VT_HideCardTab}} or {{variable.Field_MgVTCustmSet_HideBankTab}} is set to “False” (unchecked), the “New Payment Method” action will be hidden from the top action bar, but it will still be visible in the payment method dropdown list. If the {{variable.CS_VT_HideCardTab}} or {{variable.Field_MgVTCustmSet_HideBankTab}} custom settings are set to “True” (checked), all “New Payment Method” actions are disabled. Hide the Bank Tab The {{variable.Field_MgVTCustmSet_HideBankTab}} custom setting is accessed via the Blackthorn Payments | Virtual Terminal custom settings or the BT Payments LWC Virtual Terminal component settings page. If {{variable.Field_MgVTCustmSet_HideBankTab}} = “True” (enabled), the Bank tab will be hidden from the list of available {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}} types when creating a {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}} via the {{variable.Component_VirtualTerminal}} . If {{variable.Field_MgVTCustmSet_HideBankTab}} = “False” (disabled), the Bank tab will be visible. Hide the Card Tab The {{variable.CS_VT_HideCardTab}} custom setting is accessed via the Blackthorn Payments | Virtual Terminal custom settings or the BT Payments LWC Virtual Terminal component settings page. If {{variable.CS_VT_HideCardTab}} = “True” (enabled), the Card tab will be hidden from the list of available {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}} types when creating a {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}} via the {{variable.Component_VirtualTerminal}} . If {{variable.CS_VT_HideCardTab}} = “False” (disabled), the Card tab will be visible. The {{variable.CS_VT_HideCardTab}} setting can be applied to both versions of the {{variable.Component_VirtualTerminal}} . Limitation A new {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}} cannot be added via the {{variable.Component_VirtualTerminal}} when both the {{variable.CS_VT_HideCardTab}} and {{variable.Field_MgVTCustmSet_HideBankTab}} fields are enabled. CVC Optional Feature The {{variable.Field_CS_MakeCVCFieldOptional}} setting allows users to make the {{variable.Field_VT_CVC}} field optional when adding a new credit card {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}} in the {{variable.Component_VirtualTerminal}} . The default setting is for the {{variable.Field_VT_CVC}} field to be required. If {{variable.Field_CS_MakeCVCFieldOptional}} = “False”, the {{variable.Field_VT_CVC}} field is required. If {{variable.Field_CS_MakeCVCFieldOptional}} = “True”, the {{variable.Field_VT_CVC}} field is optional when adding a {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}} via the {{variable.Component_VirtualTerminal}} . The CVC Optional feature can be applied to the LWC and Aura versions at both the global level via the {{variable.CS_BlackthornPayVirtualTermina}} custom setting and locally at the {{variable.Component_BTLWCVirtualTerminal}} component level. Exception If your org has Custom Metadata Types for Virtual Terminal Mapping set, you'll need to manage those records since they can be in conflict with the {{variable.Field_MgVTCustmSet_RelToDefObj}} setting. Examples might include the following Virtual Terminal Mappings: SD.BillTo (Con) > Trans.ContactOppty.Account > TransAccount If values are set in the {{variable.Field_CstmMetaType_TargetField}} for the two mappings mentioned above, those values will take priority over the values you attempt to save in the {{variable.Field_MgVTCustmSet_RelToDefObj}} custom setting.
